overview_description.description:
Finku is a financial application that offers a personal finance platform for all Indonesians. It helps Indonesian consumers manage their finances better through financial tools. The company's mission is to eliminate financial illiteracy in Indonesia so that all Indonesians can leverage the existing financial ecosystem and make better financial decisions.

Finku was founded in 2021 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia

product.description: A service that converts uploaded bank e-statements and shopping receipts into organized financial reports with insights and recommendations.

product.name: Financial Consultation Chat Service
product.description: A chat-based service providing quick financial advice and insights from financial consultants for users with general financial questions.

product.name: Online Financial Consultation Meetings
product.description: A 60-minute online session with a financial consultant to discuss specific financial issues and develop personalized financial strategies.

product.name: Corporate Financial Wellness Program
product.description: A program offering comprehensive financial literacy training and workshops to improve employees' financial knowledge and wellbeing within companies.
